revisions.reason: Review 20261124 WATX advise v2: $run gains the header clause (no-advise "store-step"), which moves its exemption from the store-step export guard's name list (src/13a-export-guards.wat) onto the function. The clause is removed by the compiler's advice weaver before code generation and emits nothing; the canonical tail and compat wasm are byte-identical to the v1 export-wrap build. No callback producer, EIP write, boundary call or lifetime changed.
